product_metadata.title: XeGe Tie Dye Plush Shaggy Duvet Cover Set, Ombre 3 Pieces Soft Velvet Fluffy Furry Bedding Set Marble Print(1 Faux Fur Fuzzy Comforter Cover + 2 Pillowcases), Zipper Closure(Queen, Tie Dye Light Grey)
features: HIGH QUALITY MATERIAL - Experience comfort and luxury with our high-quality furry duvet cover set. The front of the fluffy duvet cover is made of shaggy plush faux fur, while the reverse is ultra-soft crystal velvet. Its resistance to fading, shedding, wrinkles, and pilling ensures it will stay looking great for a long time. You'll love how warm and comfortable this duvet cover set is, and how it brings a cozy, stylish vibe to your space. Upgrade your bedding with this must-have set today.

SIZE - Our fuzzy duvet cover sets are available in three sizes: Twin, Queen, and King. The Twin/Twin XL size includes 1 duvet cover (68"x 90") and 1 pillowcase (20"x 26"). The Queen size includes 1 duvet cover (90"x 90") and 2 pillowcases (20"x 26"), while the King size includes 1 duvet cover (104"x 90") and 2 pillowcases (20"x 36"). If you prefer, we also offer single plush shaggy quilt covers, sets of 2 pillowcases, throw blanket and plush body pillow cover sold separately in the same colors.

MULTIFUNCTION - Using a faux fur duvet cover is easy. Slip it over your comforter and close the hidden zipper. Using the four corner ties inside to keep your comforter in place and prevent shifting. On warm nights, the duvet cover can also be used as a bed blanket by simply remove your comforter. Whether you're snuggling up on a cold winter's night or using it as a light blanket during the summer months, our faux fur comforter cover is the perfect addition to your bedding collection.

TIE DYE COLOR - Our furry duvet cover sets also come in a beautiful tie-dye color design. Tie-dye is a technique of coloring fabric in a way that creates unique, organic patterns by tying/folding the fabric before dyeing it. Our tie-dye patterns are made with bright and bold colors, which can add a pop of color and energy to your bedroom. Using a tie-dye fuzzy duvet cover can give your bedroom a retro and trendy look that is both fun and stylish.

CARE INSTRUCTION - For best care, turn this tie dye light grey furry comforter cover queen size inside out and machine or hand wash it in cold water. Dry on a gentle, low-temperature cycle and avoid using heat. Do not bleach or iron. To make it fluffier, we recommend shaking the bed set before use. If you have any questions for this fluffy bedding set, please feel free to email us. We will respond within 24 hours and do our best to help you resolve any issues and provide a satisfactory solution.
